mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (id, pw, name, email, age, gender, phonenumber, birth) VALUES ( #{id}, #{pw}, #{name}, #{email}, #{age}, #{gender}, #{phonenumber}, REPLACE(#{birth}, '-', '') )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM member WHERE id = #{id} AND pw IS NOT NULL AND kakao_id IS NULL AND naver_id IS NULL AND google_id IS NULL
